vshadowinfo 20240229

Use vshadowinfo to determine information about a Windows NT Volume Shadow
Snapshot (VSS) volume

Usage: vshadowinfo [ -o offset ] [ -ahvV ] source

	source: the source file or device

	-a:     shows allocation information
	-h:     shows this help
	-o:     specify the volume offset in bytes
	-v:     verbose output to stderr
	-V:     print version

# --- stderr ---
